title: No objects
description: A scene that has nothing in it at all, which is not allowed.

title: Unknown shape
description: Uses a teapot, which is not one of the supported shapes.

title: Far away
description: Places an object far outside the allowed coordinate range.

title: Duplicate ids
description: Two objects share the same id, so references would be ambiguous.

title: Missing parent
description: An object names a parent that does not exist in the scene.

title: Parent loop
description: Two objects are each other's parent, which would never finish building.

title: Dangling link
description: A link points at an object that is not in the scene.

title: Bad step
description: A step highlights an object that does not exist in the scene.

title: Extra field
description: Carries a field the schema does not know, such as a script.

title: Bad colour
description: A colour that is not a six digit hex value is refused.
